notes: M3.8 Check 14, HARDENED by the 2026-07-19 M3 review (blocker 6b): a shard previously bumped to 'status: proved-mod-audit' whose LATEST L5 verdict (fresh: l5ContentHash matches the shard's current raw bytes) is INVALID. Previously Check 14 only queried 'status: stated' shards, so an already-promoted shard could remain 'proved-mod-audit' after a later INVALID (or an edit, or a correction-pending verdict) with zero findings -- a false validity claim. The check now continuously re-validates already-promoted shards and ERRORs to force a demote/re-verify. l5ContentHash is the real sha256 of this shard file's raw bytes (docs/worker-contract.md section (f)).
